description: 한국도로교통공단_자전거사고 다발지역 개별사고 정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels and cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로교통공단. 2015년~2020년에 선정한 자전거교통사고 다발지역에 포함된 사고의 개별정보(다발지역, 다발시군구,지점명, 사고일시, 사고내용, 가해자성별, 가해자연령, 가해차종, 가해자신체상해정도, 피해자성별, 피해차종, 피해자신체상해정도) - 자전거 사고다발지역 선정 조건 1) 대상사고: 해당 1년간 발생한... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로교통공단. Its tags are 자전거, 다발지역, 개별사고, 교통사고, 정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
